description: Shared catalogues + validation + catalogue-sync lockstep. Adds the admissions.* permission keys, the ADMISSION_OFFICER + APPLICANT roles (admissions-only officer; keep shim + legacy claim intact), the admissions.* audit keys, the admissions module (MODULE_DEPENDENCIES.admissions=[], examinations/fees exemplars intact), and the Zod validation schemas — then fills the FEAT-001 migration's seed placeholder with the pinned literal markers and registers the new dir in SEEDING_MIGRATION_DIRS so catalogue-sync is green. Depends on FEAT-001 (needs the migration dir to seed into).
steps: packages/shared/src/permissions.ts: add the 7 admissions.* keys to PERMISSIONS (module 'admissions') per design §6.2 (campaigns.manage, applications.view, applications.manage, applications.review, offers.manage, enroll, view_own). In ROLE_PERMISSIONS add ADMISSION_OFFICER (the 6 staff keys, admissions-only — NO fees/exams), APPLICANT (admissions.view_own only), and add the same 6 staff keys to ADMIN.

packages/shared/src/audit-actions.ts: add the admissions.* keys to AUDIT_ACTIONS (module 'admissions') per design §6.3: admissions.applicant.registered; admissions.campaign.created/updated/opened/closed; admissions.application.submitted/withdrawn/status_changed/rejected/enrolled; admissions.document.added/verified; admissions.review.recorded; admissions.offer.issued/accepted/declined/expired.

packages/shared/src/modules.ts: add { key: 'admissions', name: 'Admissions', description: 'Admissions (Phase 6)' } to MODULES; add admissions: [] to MODULE_DEPENDENCIES with the foundational-not-gated rationale comment (mirror the attendance/library comment). Leave examinations and fees edges untouched.

packages/shared/src/validation.ts: add the admissions Zod schemas per design §8 following the existing house style — admissionRegisterSchema, campaignConfigSchema ({ requiredFields: string[], requiredDocTypes: string[] } with bounded lengths and non-empty keys), campaign create/update, application create (self + officer-on-behalf optional applicantEmail/applicantName), document add, status-transition, offer issue/accept/decline/expire, interview-set, enroll (enrollmentNo required, optional academicSessionId). Re-export from packages/shared/src/index.ts if not already surfaced.

Fill section (j) of packages/db/prisma/migrations/20261115000000_phase6_admissions/migration.sql: INSERT the ADMISSION_OFFICER + APPLICANT roles rows (institutionId NULL, ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING — LIBRARIAN precedent); the 7 permissions rows as a single `INSERT INTO "permissions" (...) VALUES ... ON CONFLICT ("key") DO NOTHING` (the catalogue-sync parser reads from `INSERT INTO "permissions"` to `ON CONFLICT`); the role_permissions pairs (ADMISSION_OFFICER x6, ADMIN x6, APPLICANT x1) as a single `INSERT INTO "role_permissions" (...) SELECT ... FROM (VALUES (...)) AS m(...) JOIN ...` (the parser reads the pairs between `VALUES` and `AS m(`). Keep every key and (role,perm) pair as plain quoted literals — no computed SQL.
Run the fast suite and confirm catalogue-sync + modules pass.
acceptance_criteria: catalogue-sync.test.ts passes: the union of permission keys and (role,permission) pairs across all SEEDING_MIGRATION_DIRS (incl. the new Phase-6 dir) equals PERMISSION_KEYS + ROLE_PERMISSIONS in @campusgate/shared.
modules.test.ts passes: MODULES includes admissions, MODULE_DEPENDENCIES.admissions = [], the graph stays acyclic, and the examinations/fees dependency exemplars are unchanged.
ROLE_PERMISSIONS[ADMISSION_OFFICER] is a subset of the admissions.* keys (admissions-only); APPLICANT holds only admissions.view_own; ADMIN holds all six staff keys.
`npm run build -w @campusgate/api` succeeds (new Zod schemas + catalogue types compile and are importable).
findings:
DONE & VERIFIED. build (npm run build -w @campusgate/api) green; fast suite (npm test -w @campusgate/api) = 38 files / 358 tests all pass, incl. catalogue-sync (permission-key + role-permission-pair set-equality over SEEDING_MIGRATION_DIRS now incl. 20261115000000_phase6_admissions) and modules.test.ts (admissions in MODULES, MODULE_DEPENDENCIES.admissions=[], acyclic, examinations/fees exemplars untouched). NOTE: @campusgate/shared resolves its RUNTIME import to ./dist/index.js (main/exports -> dist), so after editing packages/shared/src/* you MUST run `npm run build -w @campusgate/shared` before the api tests pick up the change (the api build only rebuilds the api; it does not rebuild shared's dist). This is different from @campusgate/db which is source-only.

PERMISSION KEYS (7, module 'admissions'): admissions.campaigns.manage; admissions.applications.view; admissions.applications.manage; admissions.applications.review; admissions.offers.manage; admissions.enroll; admissions.view_own.

ROLE->PERMISSION MAPPING (ROLE_PERMISSIONS in packages/shared/src/permissions.ts, mirrored in migration section j): ADMISSION_OFFICER = the 6 staff keys [campaigns.manage, applications.view, applications.manage, applications.review, offers.manage, enroll] (admissions-only, NO fees/exams); ADMIN gains the SAME 6 staff keys (appended after library.* keys); APPLICANT = [admissions.view_own] only. STUDENT/HOD/GUARD/FACULTY/LIBRARIAN/SUPER_ADMIN get NO admissions keys. Two NEW template roles seeded (roles rows, institutionId=NULL, LIBRARIAN precedent): ADMISSION_OFFICER (id 'role_admission_officer', name 'Admission Officer') and APPLICANT (id 'role_applicant', name 'Applicant'). Legacy User.role shim untouched: applicant User.role=STUDENT, officer User.role=GUARD (inert; capability from membership role).

AUDIT KEYS (17, module 'admissions', AUDIT_ACTIONS in audit-actions.ts; NO pg enum / NO seeded rows — validated only via AUDIT_ACTION_KEY_SET in recordAuditEvent): admissions.applicant.registered; admissions.campaign.created; admissions.campaign.updated; admissions.campaign.opened; admissions.campaign.closed; admissions.application.submitted; admissions.application.withdrawn; admissions.application.status_changed; admissions.application.rejected; admissions.application.enrolled; admissions.document.added; admissions.document.verified; admissions.review.recorded; admissions.offer.issued; admissions.offer.accepted; admissions.offer.declined; admissions.offer.expired.

MODULE KEY: 'admissions' (name 'Admissions', description 'Admissions (Phase 6)') added to MODULES; MODULE_DEPENDENCIES.admissions = [] with the foundational-not-gated rationale comment (mirrors attendance/library). Every operational admissions route should carry requireModuleActive('admissions') per design §6.1.

VALIDATION SCHEMA NAMES (packages/shared/src/validation.ts, section 'ADMISSIONS (Phase 6)', all re-exported via index.ts's `export * from ./validation.js`): enums admissionCampaignStatusEnum, applicationStatusEnum, applicationReviewDecisionEnum, admissionOfferStatusEnum; admissionRegisterSchema ({institutionId,email,password>=8,name>=2} .strict — the ONE token-exception, PUBLIC register); campaignConfigSchema ({requiredFields:string[], requiredDocTypes:string[]} .strict, bounded <=50 each, non-empty keys, both .default([])); createCampaignSchema / updateCampaignSchema (openAt<=closeAt refine; update uses .nullish() for clearable fields + optional programIds); createApplicationSchema (campaignId, programId, optional formData record, optional applicantEmail/applicantName for officer-on-behalf); addApplicationDocumentSchema (docType, reference, optional fileName/contentType); changeApplicationStatusSchema ({status, optional reason}); submitApplicationSchema ({}.strict); withdrawApplicationSchema ({optional reason}); recordApplicationReviewSchema ({decision, optional notes}); setApplicationInterviewSchema ({interviewAt datetime}); issueOfferSchema ({offeredProgramId, optional expiresAt}); acceptOfferSchema ({}.strict); declineOfferSchema ({optional reason}); expireOfferSchema ({}.strict); enrollApplicationSchema ({enrollmentNo required, optional academicSessionId}). Inferred-type exports named <SchemaName>Input / <Enum>Value follow the file convention (e.g. CreateCampaignInput, EnrollApplicationInput, ApplicationStatusValue).

MIGRATION SEED (section j of packages/db/prisma/migrations/20261115000000_phase6_admissions/migration.sql) now filled with the literal markers: INSERT INTO "roles" ... (2 rows) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING; INSERT INTO "permissions" ... VALUES (7 rows) ON CONFLICT ("key") DO NOTHING; INSERT INTO "role_permissions" ... SELECT ... FROM (VALUES ... 13 pairs) AS m("roleKey","permKey") JOIN roles JOIN permissions ON CONFLICT ("roleId","permissionId") DO NOTHING. All keys/pairs are plain quoted literals (parser-friendly). REMINDER (from FEAT-001): this migration is ALREADY DEPLOYED to the shared DB, so `prisma migrate deploy` will NOT re-run the now-filled section j — the live catalogue rows must be applied separately via `npm run db:seed -w @campusgate/db` (seedRbacCatalogue iterates ROLE_PERMISSIONS, so the two new template roles + pairs seed from shared). FEAT-002 did NOT run the live seed (fast/mocked verification only, per its verification list).
